quest.title: Language Exchange
quest.description: Ella Musk wants to find a group of hilichurls to practice her Hilichurlian. She claims to have a solid grasp of the basics, as well as plenty of communication experience... It's just that she's never had a chance to actually speak with them.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure, let me go drag one out for you.

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: Wait! No! My word, just who exactly taught you to go bashing hilichurls around like that!?

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: Let's compose ourselves, go over there together, and politely introduce ourselves.

talks.objective: Go to the hilichurl camp with Ella Musk

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: Thankfully there's one awake right now.

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: This is him, let's go over and say hi.

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: Be careful though, it would be rude of us to wake the others.

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: We don't want them thinking we're storming into their camp to attack them.

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: There's absolutely no way they would talk to us then.

talks.objective: Approach the hilichurl that is awake, but don't wake the others

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: I said not to startle the other hilichurls! Have you really never tried to approach a hilichurl camp quietly!?

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: Ugh. There's no more hilichurls left at this camp. Such a great opportunity, completely wasted. All I can do now is wait until next time.

talks.objective: The hilichurls have been startled awake

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Perhaps it's better that you go alone.

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: That won't do! This is a rare opportunity. Even if you just want to slack off, I'm not letting you get off that easily!

talks.objective: Talk to the hilichurl with Ella Musk

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: Olah! Muhe mimi, nye, eh... mosi aba?

dialogues.speaker: Hilichurl
dialogues.text: Yo mimi beru si?

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: Buka...mita nye, guru-guru...yo mosi ka?

dialogues.speaker: Hilichurl
dialogues.text: Ya odomu, Todo yo, buka guru-guru nye.

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: Mi? Dada! Valo.

dialogues.speaker: Hilichurl
dialogues.text: Valo, ya odomu.

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: Hehe, look at how he's acting. He seems so happy!

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: Looks like this time has finally been a success, and my Hilichurlian has finally improved.

talks.objective: Talk to the hilichurl with Ella Musk

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: Biat ye, ye pupu dada mosi! Plama ye upa dada!

dialogues.speaker: Hilichurl
dialogues.text: Dala beru yo!? Kundala muhe, kucha?

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: Kundala gusha! Hahaha!

dialogues.speaker: Hilichurl
dialogues.text: Biat ye, plata ye pupu!

dialogues.speaker: Hilichurl
dialogues.text: Movo unta nye kucha, mi dada tiga mitono!

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: Oh! I think he understood me! He seems to be taking out something to show us...

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: Oh, oh no! It's a weapon! Traveler, help me!

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: What do you think? My Hilichurlian is not bad, huh? Now that we can communicate, all that's needed to understand each other is time.

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: That's what I hope for anyway. My dream, is to become friends with the hilichurls.

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: Oh, right! Before I forget — take this. It's a present from that hilichurl.

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: A present from a hilichurl. Bet you never thought you'd see the day!

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: Well I better get going, I have so many new discoveries to note down. Perhaps we'll have a chance to meet again.

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: Oh shoot! They've all been woken up!

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: Be careful though, it would be rude of us to wake the others.

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: We don't want them thinking we're storming into their camp to attack them.

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: There's absolutely no way they would talk to us then.

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: Good thing you were here, otherwise I would have no idea what would have happened to me.

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: I don't think I said anything wrong... Maybe my pronunciation was off...?

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: Guess I better hit the books again and do some more research before trying again...

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: Traveler! Here! Over here!

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: Don't startle those hilichurls over there. Why are you always running off into hilichurl camps?

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: Forget it, it's not important. I've been researching Hilichurlian for some time, but I'd much rather get in some actual speaking practice than constantly going over books.

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: I've finally stumbled across a whole hilichurl camp... I cannot let this opportunity pass me by!

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: So, Traveler, can you go with me into the camp and help me find a hilichurl to practice with?
